attempts.prompt:
CACE Imatges, school-friendly wordless educational narrative. Deliver one wide landscape image. EXACTLY FOUR equal vertical panels in ONE horizontal row from left to right, with pure white margins and three consistent white gutters. Never merge panels, use a second row, crop the first or last panel or insert an inset panel. Clear simplified setting against white with only needed cues. Medium-wide full-action views, eye-level slightly oblique, matching camera position, perspective, dimensions, anatomy, scale, lighting, hair/fur, clothes and object shapes across panels. Repeat the same two characters scene to scene. Favor visual evidence of their actions, visible distinct hands and physical points of contact. No cut-off hands, warped fingers, floating objects, implausible contact, lettering, branding, numbers, panel labels, arrows, speech bubbles, captions or motion graphics. The internal codes A and B are directions only. Preserve every count and all patterns. Stage the action as a natural coherent story.
Flat two-dimensional cartoon. Exactly two anthropomorphic animal characters.
Cast: A is CONILL, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is TIGRE, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
The rabbit plants, the tiger assists and waters. EXACTLY FOUR seedlings with paired leaves: upper left lime round, upper right dark green round, lower left light green pointed, lower right dark green pointed. P1 four seedlings in a wide FOUR-BAY tray in two-by-two arrangement; rabbit points to an empty soil bed with two short rows, tiger holds tray. P2 the two round-leaf seedlings already in the back row; the TWO pointed-leaf seedlings still sit in the front two bays of tiger's tray, the other two bays empty. P3 all four planted, tiger pours water on the earth with a narrow pitcher, rabbit steadies a front seedling. P4 FOUR seedlings, unchanged arrangement and size, watered earth darkened, both pleased. Simple 3/4 overhead view; exactly four plants each panel, no decor.
attempts.review: Els quatre plançons es conserven del planter a l’hort. Hi ha dos arrodonits darrere i dos punxeguts davant; el conill planta i el tigre acaba regant.
